sentence: This project builds a framework that helps 3D geometric information flow from engineering design into analysis and manufacturing.
This project studies how duplicated genes evolve and affect traits in the nightshade family, including eggplant, pepino, and tomato.
This project builds a shared laboratory that uses autonomous robotics and artificial intelligence to discover and make advanced polymeric materials.
This project builds and tests modules that bring language-based artificial intelligence into the high school curriculum for mathematics, English language arts, and history.
This project studies harmonic maps between geometric spaces to find out what they reveal about the spaces.
This project builds mathematical, computational, and visualization tools that help scientists understand uncertainty in large simulation ensembles.
This project builds cryptographic tools that check where data and models come from in artificial intelligence used in scientific research and medicine.
This project studies quantum emission in 2D materials and the mechanical behavior of those materials on the substrates that support them.
This project builds a small chip and surgical probe that use analog circuits to tell cancerous tissue from healthy tissue in removed prostates.
This project improves fire regime models so they predict fire behavior more accurately and give clearer measures of uncertainty.
This project tries to speed up computing on encrypted data in neural networks by designing algorithms and hardware together.
This project designs materials with engineered vertical interfaces to make memristors switch resistance in a reliable, multi-state way.
This project builds DNA-encoded libraries of light-responsive molecules and uses them to find protein binders that are controlled by light.
This project builds a framework that helps autonomous systems detect and respond to unexpected disruptions in real time without human intervention.
This project builds diagnostics and modeling tools for experiments at national high power laser facilities.
